"""AC1: an expired coupon shows the field error, keeps the code and the $100 total."""

from conftest import ERROR, TOTAL, apply_code


def test_ac1_expired_coupon_keeps_code(checkout):
    page = checkout()
    apply_code(page, "EXPIRED")
    error = page.locator(ERROR)
    assert error.is_visible(), "no field error after an expired coupon"
    assert error.inner_text() == "This coupon has expired"
    assert page.input_value("#coupon") == "EXPIRED", "the entered code was cleared"
    assert page.inner_text(TOTAL) == "Total: $100"
